faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in October 2028?
faq.a: October in Marbella is mild and pleasant, with daytime air temperatures between 20-25°C and sea temperatures around 20-22°C. Expect 7-8 hours of sunshine daily, light winds (5-10 knots), and calm seas with swells of 0.5-1m. Evenings cool down to 15-18°C, so a light jacket is useful.

faq.q: Is October a good time for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, October is an excellent shoulder-season month for boat rentals. The weather is still warm enough for swimming and sunbathing, but crowds are thinner, and prices are often lower than peak summer. Sea conditions are typically calm, making for smooth cruises along the Costa del Sol.

faq.q: Where can we sail in October from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Popular October routes include heading west to Cabopino or Cala del Faro for lunch, or east to Estepona and Sotogrande. Cala Cortés is a great spot for a swim. The sea is calm enough to explore the coastline comfortably.

faq.q: What should I wear for a boat trip in October?
faq.a: Daytime wear: swimsuit, shorts, t-shirt, and sunglasses. Bring a light jacket or sweater for the evening, as temperatures drop to 15-18°C. Non-slip shoes are recommended. Sunscreen is still essential despite the lower UV index.

faq.q: Can we swim in the sea in October in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, the sea temperature in October is around 20-22°C, which is comfortable for swimming, especially during midday. Most guests enjoy a dip at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. A wetsuit is optional but not necessary for short swims.

October 2028 Weather Overview for Marbella

October in Marbella is defined by stable high pressure, bringing sunny skies and gentle breezes. Average highs reach 24-25°C, with lows of 15-18°C after sunset. Sea surface temperatures remain swim-friendly at 20-22°C. Wind speeds typically range from 5-10 knots, and swells rarely exceed 1m. Rainfall is low — only 3-4 rainy days on average. These conditions make October one of the best months for a Marbella boat rental weather October 2028 search yields ideal cruising parameters.

Why Choose October for Your Boat Rental?

Shoulder season means lower demand, more availability, and often better rates. You’ll find Puerto Banús less crowded, with easier mooring at popular spots like Cabopino and Estepona. The sea is calm enough for families, and the sun is still strong enough for sunbathing. Plus, you can enjoy a full 8-hour charter on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 for just €2,299 — all inclusive.
